title: RED-2400: A Public Benchmark of Algorithmically-Rejected Trading Events with Outcome Labels
abstract: arXiv:2605.12151v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: RED-2400 is a public benchmark of 6,660 algorithmically-rejected trading events from a live Solana decentralised-exchange filter stack, observed continuously over 22 calendar days (2026-04-10T21:10Z through 2026-05-02T21:48Z, UTC). Of the 6,660 rejection events, 3,333 (50.05 percent) link exactly to a post-rejection price-and-liquidity sample series. The deposit contains 169,123 forward-outcome observations and 1,837 graveyard-tracker lifecycle snapshots, covering 1,076 distinct mints in the rejection registry and 1,075 in the forward-observation file. The deposit contains no outcome-label column. In its lifecycle-tracker file, gone is a tracker state recorded with liquidity 0; it is not terminal (167 of the 377 mints that reach it later return to an alive state) and does not denote token death or a rug pull. translated_title: RED-2400：带有结果标签的算法拒绝交易事件公开基准
translated_abstract: RED-2400 是一个公开基准数据集，收录了来自线上运行的 Solana 去中心化交易所过滤系统栈的 6,660 个被算法拒绝的交易事件，在 22 个日历日内连续观测（2026-04-10T21:10Z 至 2026-05-02T21:48Z，UTC）。在 6,660 个拒绝事件中，有 3,333 个（50.05%）精确关联到拒绝后的价格与流动性样本序列。该数据集包含 169,123 条前瞻结果观测和 1,837 个墓地追踪器生命周期快照，覆盖拒绝注册表中的 1,076 个不同代币铸造以及前瞻观测文件中的 1,075 个。该数据集不包含结果标签列。在其生命周期追踪文件中，“gone”（消失）是记录流动性为 0 的追踪器状态；它并非终态（到达该状态的 377 个代币中有 167 个后来恢复到“存活”状态），也不代表代币死亡或“rug pull”（卷款跑路）。过滤器标签被匿名化为 filter_1 至 filter_8；来源采集器标识符被匿名化为 source_a 和 source_b。流动性……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了 RED-2400——一个收录 6,660 个来自线上 Solana 去中心化交易所过滤系统栈的算法拒绝交易事件、并附带 169,123 条拒绝后价格与流动性结果观测的公开基准数据集，同时澄清了"gone"追踪器状态并非代币终态，为评估交易拒绝过滤器提供了可复用的研究资源。
en_tdlr: This paper releases RED-2400, a public benchmark of 6,660 algorithmically-rejected trading events from a live Solana DEX filter stack with 169,123 post-rejection price-and-liquidity outcome observations, clarifying that the "gone" tracker state is non-terminal and enabling evaluation of trading rejection filters.
